text.en: Tim has a small white cat. The cat likes to sleep on the red mat.
text.zh: 蒂姆有一只流行的小白猫。猫喜欢睡在红色的垫子上。

text.en: Sam plays with a big red ball. He rolls the ball to his brother.
text.zh: 萨姆在玩一个很大的红球。他把球滚给了他的弟弟。

questions.q: Who does Sam roll the ball to?
What does Sam do with the ball?

text.en: The sun is very bright today. Lily drinks cold water to stay cool.
text.zh: 今天太阳非常明亮。莉莉喝凉水来保持凉爽。

questions.q: What is the sun like today?
What does Lily drink water to do?

text.en: A yellow bird sings in the green tree. The bird eats a tiny worm.
text.zh: 一只黄色的鸟在绿色的树上唱歌。小鸟吃了一条小虫子。

text.en: Ben wears his new blue shoes to school. He runs fast on the playground.
text.zh: 本穿着他的新蓝色鞋子去上学。他在操场上跑得很快。

questions.q: What color are Ben's new shoes?
Where does Ben wear his shoes?
What is Ben like when he runs on the playground?

text.en: A small green frog sits on a rock. It jumps into the pond with a splash.
text.zh: 一只小绿青蛙坐在石头上。它啪嗒一声跳进了池塘里。

text.en: Mia eats a sweet red apple for her snack. She gives one to her friend.
text.zh: 米娅吃了一个甜甜的红苹果当作零食。她给了朋友一个。

questions.q: What does the apple taste like?
Who does Mia give an apple to?

text.en: Tom rides his yellow bike in the park. He wears a dark helmet on his head.
text.zh: 汤姆在公园里骑他的黄色自行车。他头上戴着一个深色的头盔。

questions.q: Where does Tom ride his bike?
What does Tom wear on his head?

text.en: Rain falls from the gray clouds outside. Dan stays inside and reads a fun book.
text.zh: 外面灰色的云彩里下着雨。丹待在家里看一本有趣的书。

questions.q: What is falling from the clouds?

text.en: Max is a friendly brown dog. He barks happily when his owner comes home.
text.zh: 马克斯是一只友好的棕色狗。当主人回家时，他高兴地叫着。

questions.q: What kind of animal is Max?
What is Max like when he barks?

text.en: Emma has a soft brown teddy bear. She hugs it when she goes to sleep.
text.zh: 艾玛有一只软绵绵的棕色泰迪熊。她睡觉时抱着它。

questions.q: What color is the teddy bear?
When does Emma hug her teddy bear?

text.en: Leo drinks a glass of fresh warm milk every morning. It helps him grow strong.
text.zh: 里奥每天早上喝一杯新鲜的温牛奶。这有助于他健康成长。

questions.q: What does Leo drink every morning?
When does Leo drink the milk?
What does milk do for Leo?

text.en: A small yellow duck swims in the quiet lake. It catches a small fish.
text.zh: 一只黄色的小鸭子在宁静的湖里游泳。它抓到了一条小鱼。

questions.q: What color is the little duck?

text.en: Anna grows bright yellow flowers in her garden. She waters them with a little can.
text.zh: 安娜在花园里种了鲜艳的黄花。她用一个小水壶给它们浇水。

questions.q: What does Anna grow in her garden?
What does Anna use to water the flowers?

text.en: Jack flies his diamond kite on a windy hill. The kite goes high up in the blue sky.
text.zh: 杰克在一个有风的山丘上放风筝。风筝飞上了蓝天的高处。

questions.q: Where does Jack fly his kite?

text.en: The big yellow bus takes kids to school. The driver smiles and says good morning.
text.zh: 这辆黄色的大公交车接孩子们去上学。司机微笑并说早上好。

questions.q: Where does the bus take the kids?

text.en: The mountain stream has clear cool water. Two small fish swim fast in it.
text.zh: 山间小溪水清凉干净。两条小鱼在里面游得很快。

questions.q: What is the water in the stream like?
What number of fish swim in the stream?
What are the fish like when they swim?

text.en: A tall red bus stops in front of the shop. Many people get off with big bags.
text.zh: 一辆高大的红巴士停在商店门前。许多人拿着大包下车。

text.en: Mom bakes a sweet chocolate cake for dinner. She puts three strawberries on top.
text.zh: 妈妈为晚餐烘焙了一个甜甜的巧克力蛋糕。她在上面放了三个草莓。

questions.q: When does Mom bake the cake?
What does Mom put on top?

text.en: An old oak tree stands in the middle of the yard. Green leaves cover all its branches.
text.zh: 一棵老橡树站在院子中央。绿叶覆盖着它所有的树枝。

questions.q: What tree stands in the yard?

options: In the middle of the yard

text.en: A funny brown monkey hangs from a thick vine. It eats a ripe yellow banana.
text.zh: 一只滑稽的棕色猴子挂在厚厚的藤蔓上。它吃着成熟的黄香蕉。

questions.q: What does the monkey hang from?
What food does the monkey eat?

text.en: A fluffy white rabbit hops across the soft grass. It wiggles its pink nose happily.
text.zh: 一只毛茸茸的白兔子在柔软的草地上跳跃。它高兴地动着粉红色的鼻子。

questions.q: What does the rabbit do on the grass?

text.en: Leo kicks the black and white soccer ball into the net. His team cheers out loud.
text.zh: 里奥把黑白相间的足球踢进网里。他的球队高声欢呼。

text.en: A bright star shines high in the night sky. Ella watches the star from her bedroom window.
text.zh: 一颗明亮的星星高挂在夜空中。艾拉从卧室的窗户看着星星。

questions.q: Where does Ella watch the star from?

text.en: White snow covers the quiet town in winter. Toby makes a big round snowman.
text.zh: 冬天白雪覆盖着安静的小镇。托比做了个又大又圆的雪人。

text.en: Lily and Dan ride the swings at the neighborhood park. They laugh loudly as they swing high up.
text.zh: 莉莉和丹在社区公园荡秋千。当他们荡得很高时，他们大声笑了起来。

questions.q: What are Lily and Dan like when they laugh?
Where do Lily and Dan swing?

text.en: A line of tiny black ants carries bread crumbs to their nest. They work together all afternoon.
text.zh: 一队黑色的小蚂蚁把面包屑搬到蚁巢里。他们整个下午都在一起工作。

questions.q: Where do they carry the food?

text.en: Oliver slices a fresh yellow banana into small pieces. He eats the fruit with sweet yogurt.
text.zh: 奥利弗把新鲜的黄香蕉切成小块。他配着甜酸奶吃水果。

questions.q: What does Oliver do to the banana?
What does he eat the fruit with?

text.en: Amy sprinkles fish food into the glass bowl. Three bright orange goldfish swim up to eat.
text.zh: 艾米把鱼食洒进玻璃碗里。三条鲜艳的橙色金鱼游上来吃。

questions.q: Where does Amy sprinkle fish food?
What number of goldfish are in the bowl?
What do goldfish swim up to do?

text.en: Noah uses wet sand to build a tall castle on the beach. He puts a small red flag on the top.
text.zh: 诺亚用湿沙在海滩上建了一座高高的城堡。他在顶端放了一面红色的小旗。

questions.q: What color is the flag on top?

text.en: Grace paints a blue ocean with a big green ship. She uses a bright brush to color the waves.
text.zh: 格蕾丝画了一片蓝色的海洋和艘绿色的大船。她用亮丽的画笔给海浪上色。

options: A blue ocean with a ship

text.en: A small turtle walks slowly along the river bank. It pulls its head into its hard green shell.
text.zh: 一只小乌龟沿着河岸慢慢地走着。它把头伸进硬硬的绿壳里。

questions.q: What is the turtle like when it walks?
Where does the turtle pull its head?
What color is the turtle's shell?

text.en: The wind blows strongly across the wide green field. Kids run fast and fly colorful kites high up.
text.zh: 风在宽广的绿野上猛烈地吹着。孩子们快速跑着，把五彩缤纷的风筝放得高高的。

questions.q: What are the children like when they run?

text.en: Leo pours sweet orange juice into a tall glass with ice. He drinks it after playing sports outside.
text.zh: 里奥把甜橙汁倒入带有冰块的高玻璃杯里。他在外面做完运动后喝了它。

questions.q: When does Leo drink the juice?
What kind of glass is it?

text.en: A cute brown puppy wags its short tail happily. It runs around the yard to chase a red ball.
text.zh: 一只可爱的小棕狗高兴地摇着短尾巴。它在院子里跑来跑去追红球。

text.en: Grandma plants small green seeds in the soft dark soil. She waters the garden every afternoon.
text.zh: 奶奶在柔软的黑土里种下了绿色的种子。她每天下午给花园浇水。

questions.q: When does she water the garden?

text.en: Fluffy the cat lies on the soft sofa near the window. She purrs quietly and closes her eyes.
text.zh: 弗拉菲这只猫躺在窗户附近的软沙发上。她轻轻地发出咕噜声并闭上了眼睛。

questions.q: What is the cat like when it purrs?

text.en: Jack turns on his small desk lamp after dinner. He reads an exciting story about wild animals.
text.zh: 杰克晚餐后打开了他的小台灯。他读了一个关于野生动物的令人兴奋的故事。

questions.q: When does he turn on the lamp?

text.en: The baker puts warm round bread on the wooden counter. It smells delicious and tastes fresh.
text.zh: 面包师把温暖的圆面包放在木台面上。它闻起来很香，尝起来很新鲜。

questions.q: Who puts bread on the counter?
What is the counter made of?
What does the bread smell like?

text.en: Grandpa walks slowly down the quiet street with his golden retriever. They stop to look at yellow flowers.
text.zh: 爷爷带着他的金毛犬沿着安静的街道慢走。他们停下来看黄色的花。

questions.q: What flowers do they stop to look at?

text.en: Class One visits the city zoo on a bright sunny Tuesday. The students cheer happily when they see two tall giraffes.
text.zh: 一班在阳光明媚的星期二参观了城市动物园。当学生们看到两只高高的长颈鹿时，高兴地欢呼起来。

questions.q: What animals do the students see?
What do the students do when they see giraffes?

text.en: Mr Green drives a clean blue bus around the busy town every day. He always smiles and greets all passengers warmly.
text.zh: 格林先生每天开着一辆干净的蓝色公交车在繁忙的小镇上穿行。他总是面带微笑，热情地招呼所有的乘客。

questions.q: Where does he drive the bus?
What is Mr Green like with passengers?

text.en: Old John keeps five white sheep and ten brown hens on his farm. The hens lay fresh eggs in the straw every morning.
text.zh: 老约翰在他的农场里养了五只白羊和十只棕色母鸡。每天早上母鸡都在干草里产新鲜的鸡蛋。

questions.q: What number of sheep does he keep?
What number of hens does he keep?

text.en: Sally cleans her bedroom carefully every Saturday morning. She folds her clothes and puts all her books on the shelf.
text.zh: 萨莉每个星期六早上都仔细清洁她的卧室。她折好衣服，把所有的书放在架子上。

questions.q: When does she clean her room?
What is Sally like while she cleans?
Where does she put her books?

text.en: The new toy store on Main Street opens at nine in the morning. Children rush in to look at shiny colorful trains.
text.zh: 主街上的新玩具店早上九点开门。孩子们冲进去看闪闪发光的彩色火车。

questions.q: Where is the new toy store?
What toys do children look at?

text.en: Peter and his family eat sandwiches under a big oak tree. They drink cold lemonade and play fun board games.
text.zh: 彼得和他的家人在大橡树下吃三明治。他们喝冰镇柠檬水，玩有趣的棋盘游戏。

text.en: A small yellow bee flies from flower to flower in the sun. It collects sweet nectar to make honey for its hive.
text.zh: 一只黄色的小蜜蜂在阳光下从一朵花飞到另一朵花。它收集甜甜的花蜜来为蜂巢做蜂蜜。

questions.q: What animal is in the story?
Where does the bee take the food?

text.en: Jenny visits the town library to borrow a picture book about space. She sits in a cozy red chair to read.
text.zh: 珍妮去镇上的图书馆借一本关于太空的绘本。她坐在舒适的红椅子上看书。

questions.q: What does Jenny do in the chair?

text.en: Sam and his sister build a snowman with a carrot nose and coal eyes. They put a bright red scarf around its neck.
text.zh: 萨姆和他的妹妹做了一个有着胡萝卜鼻子和煤炭眼睛的雪人。他们在它的脖子上围了一条鲜红色的围巾。

questions.q: What is the snowman's nose made of?
What are the eyes made of?
Where do they put the scarf?

text.en: Mom and Toby mix butter and sugar to bake round oat cookies. The kitchen smells sweet as the cookies bake in the oven.
text.zh: 妈妈和托比混合黄油和糖来烘焙圆形燕麦饼干。当饼干在烤箱里烘烤时，厨房里弥漫着甜香味。

questions.q: What kind of cookies do they make?
What does the kitchen smell like?

text.en: Farmer Dan picks red apples on his apple farm each autumn. He puts the apples in big wooden boxes. Then he drives a green tractor to sell them at the market.
text.zh: 农夫丹每年秋天都在苹果园里摘红苹果。他把苹果放进大木箱里。然后，他开着绿色拖拉机去市场卖苹果。

questions.q: When does Farmer Dan pick apples?
Where does he put the apples?
Where does he sell the apples?

text.en: A big sea turtle swims in the warm blue sea. It uses its long flippers to swim past colorful coral. Later, it rests on the sand under the bright sun.
text.zh: 一只大海龟在温暖的蓝色大海里游泳。它用长长的鳍游过彩色的珊瑚。后来，它在明亮的太阳下躺在沙滩上休息。

questions.q: What animal swims in the sea?
What does the turtle use to swim?
What does the turtle swim past?

text.en: Dark clouds fill the sky on a cool Monday morning. Maya puts on her yellow raincoat and yellow boots. She splashes in clear puddles on her way to school.
text.zh: 一个凉爽的星期一早上，乌云布满天空。玛雅穿上黄色雨衣和黄色雨靴。她去学校的路上在清水坑里踩水。

questions.q: What does Maya wear on her feet?

text.en: Students meet in the school hall for the yearly music show. Clara plays a song on her violin for the people there. Everyone claps when she finishes her song.
text.zh: 学生们在学校礼堂参加每年的音乐表演。克拉拉为大家拉小提琴。她演奏完后，大家都鼓掌。

questions.q: Who meets for the music show?
What do people do when Clara finishes?

text.en: David and his dad put up a green tent by a clear forest stream. They make a small fire to cook sausages for dinner. At night, they look at bright stars in the sky.
text.zh: 大卫和爸爸在清澈的森林小溪边搭起绿色帐篷。他们生了小火，做香肠当晚饭。晚上，他们看天上的亮星星。

questions.q: Where do they put up the tent?
What do they cook for dinner?
When do they look at stars?
What do they see in the sky?

text.en: A silver dolphin jumps high out of the shining sea. It does two flips and splashes back into the water. People on a tour boat clap and cheer.
text.zh: 一只银色海豚从闪亮的大海里高高跳起。它翻了两次身，又落回水里。游船上的人拍手欢呼。

questions.q: What animal jumps out of the sea?
What does the dolphin do before it falls back?
Where does the dolphin splash back?
Who is on the tour boat?

text.en: Farmers work under the autumn sun to cut wheat. Big yellow machines cut the dry wheat in the field. By evening, the barns are full of grain.
text.zh: 农民在秋天的阳光下收割小麦。黄色的大机器在田里割干小麦。到了晚上，谷仓里装满了粮食。

questions.q: What color are the big machines?

text.en: The city library has many books on neat wooden shelves. Children sit at round tables to do schoolwork quietly. Library workers help people find books.
text.zh: 城市图书馆的整齐木书架上有很多书。孩子们坐在圆桌旁安静地做作业。图书管理员帮助大家找书。

questions.q: What do children do at the tables?

text.en: An artist puts soft gray clay on a turning wheel. She uses wet hands to make it into a round vase. After the hot oven, the vase turns blue.
text.zh: 一位艺术家把软软的灰色泥放在转盘上。她用湿手把它做成圆花瓶。放进热窑后，花瓶变成蓝色。

questions.q: What does the artist put on the wheel?
What does she use to shape the clay?
Where does the vase go after it is made?
What color does the vase turn?

text.en: Leo looks through his telescope on a clear summer night. He sees holes on the bright moon. He watches a shooting star move across the sky.
text.zh: 一个晴朗的夏夜，利奥用望远镜看天空。他看见明亮月亮上的坑。他看着一颗流星划过天空。

questions.q: When does Leo use the telescope?
What does Leo see on the moon?
What does Leo watch move in the sky?
Where does the shooting star move?

desc.en: Learn when to use 'a' and 'an'.
desc.zh: 学习何时使用 'a' 和 'an'。

rule.en: Use 'a' before a consonant sound (a cat) and 'an' before a vowel sound (an apple).
rule.zh: 辅音发音前用 a（a cat）；元音发音前用 an（an apple）。

desc.en: Learn to use I, You, He, She, It, We, and They.
desc.zh: 学习使用 I, You, He, She, It, We, They。

rule.en: Use He for a boy, She for a girl, It for a thing/animal, and They for more than one person.
rule.zh: 男用 He，女用 She，物体/动物用 It，复数用 They。

desc.en: Add -s or -es to make words plural.
desc.zh: 在词尾加 -s 或 -es 表示复数。

rule.en: Add '-s' to most nouns, and '-es' to words ending in x, ch, sh, or s.
rule.zh: 大多数名词加 '-s'，以 x, ch, sh, s 结尾的词加 '-es'。

desc.en: Learn when to use am, is, and are.
desc.zh: 学习何时使用 am, is, 和 are。

rule.en: Use 'am' with I, 'is' with He/She/It (singular), and 'are' with You/We/They (plural).
rule.zh: I 用 am，单数（He/She/It）用 is，复数（You/We/They）用 are。

My dog and cat ___ good friends.

desc.en: Use 'this' for near items and 'that' for far items.
desc.zh: 用 'this' 表示近处，'that' 表示远处。

rule.en: Use 'this' when holding or near an object, and 'that' when pointing to something far.
rule.zh: 拿着或靠近物体时用 'this'，指向远处物体时用 'that'。

title.en: Possessive Adjectives: My, Your, His, Her
title.zh: 物主代词：My, Your, His, Her

desc.en: Show who owns something.
desc.zh: 表示物品所属关系。

rule.en: Use my (belonging to me), your (belonging to you), his (belonging to a boy), and her (belonging to a girl).
rule.zh: my（我的），your（你的），his（他的），her（她的）。

text.en: Class Three students planted a small garden behind their school. They grew red tomatoes and green peas there. Everyone watered the vegetables after lunch.
text.zh: 三年级的学生在学校后面种了一个小菜园。他们在那里种了红番茄和青豌豆。每个人午饭后都给蔬菜浇水。

questions.q: Where is the school garden located?
When did students water the garden?

text.en: Leo went to his uncle's farm with cows in the spring holiday. He fed the young cows warm milk from bottles. He watched fresh milk go into big metal buckets.
text.zh: 春假时，利奥去了叔叔的奶牛场。他用奶瓶里的温牛奶喂小牛。他看着新鲜牛奶装进大金属桶里。

questions.q: What does Leo use to feed the calves?

text.en: Sam and his father made a wooden birdhouse on Saturday afternoon. They painted the outside light blue and put on a small round roof. Then they hung it high on a thick tree branch.
text.zh: 星期六下午，山姆和爸爸做了一个木鸟屋。他们把外面刷成浅蓝色，还装上一个小圆屋顶。然后他们把它高高挂在粗树枝上。

questions.q: When did Sam build the birdhouse?
What color did they paint the walls?
Where did they hang the birdhouse?
options: High up on an oak branch

text.en: Honeybees fly across green fields to find sweet flower food. They do a special dance to tell other bees where to go. Their home stays full of honey when they work together.
text.zh: 蜜蜂飞过绿色田野去找甜甜的花蜜。它们跳特别的舞，告诉别的蜜蜂该去哪里。它们一起干活，蜂房里就有很多蜂蜜。

questions.q: What do honeybees travel across fields to find?
What do bees use to communicate with others?
What stays full in their hive?

text.en: Maya played by the sea on a hot summer afternoon. She put smooth, colorful shells in a yellow bucket. Before she left, she made a big sandcastle with a red flag.
text.zh: 炎热的夏日下午，玛雅在海边玩。她把光滑、彩色的贝壳放进黄色桶里。离开前，她做了一个插着红旗的大沙堡。

questions.q: Where did Maya spend her afternoon?
What did she build before leaving?

text.en: Ben joined a new swimming class at the town center. His teacher showed him how to kick his legs and float on his back. In the third week, Ben swam safely across the shallow pool.
text.zh: 本在镇活动中心参加了初学游泳班。老师教他踢腿和仰面漂浮。到了第三周，本能安全地游过浅水池。

questions.q: Where did Ben join the swimming class?
What did his coach teach him first?
When could Ben swim across the pool?

text.en: Dolphins are smart animals that live together in warm sea water. They use clicks and whistles to talk under the water. Sometimes they jump high to play near boats.
text.zh: 海豚是聪明的动物，它们一起生活在温暖的海水里。它们用咔哒声和口哨声在水下说话。有时它们在船边高高跳起玩耍。

questions.q: What kind of animals are dolphins?
What do dolphins use to talk underwater?
What do dolphins do near passing boats?

text.en: Emma goes to the library near her home every Friday afternoon. She borrows storybooks about magic castles and old rainforest animals. The quiet place helps her read without noise.
text.zh: 艾玛每个星期五下午都去家附近的图书馆。她借关于魔法城堡和古老雨林动物的故事书。安静的地方让她能不受噪声打扰地阅读。

questions.q: When does Emma visit the library?
What topics are her storybooks about?
What does the quiet library help Emma do?

text.en: Grandma and Lucy made a warm apple pie for dessert. They peeled red apples and mixed them with cinnamon. The house smelled very good while the pie baked in the oven.
text.zh: 奶奶和露西做了一个热苹果派当甜点。她们削了红苹果，还拌上肉桂粉。苹果派在烤箱里烤时，屋里闻起来很香。

questions.q: What dessert did Grandma and Lucy make?
What spice did they mix with apples?
What did the house smell like while baking?

text.en: Oliver put his small telescope on the grass behind his house. At midnight, he looked at holes on the bright moon. He also saw shooting stars flash across the sky.
text.zh: 奥利弗把小望远镜放在房子后面的草地上。半夜，他看明亮月亮上的坑。他还看见流星闪过天空。

questions.q: Where did Oliver set up his telescope?
What did Oliver observe on the moon?

text.en: Tom washed three sweet oranges and cut them in half. He squeezed the juice into a clean glass with ice. He drank the cold juice after his long bike ride.
text.zh: 汤姆洗了三个甜橙子，并把它们切成两半。他把果汁挤进装有冰的干净玻璃杯里。骑了很久的自行车后，他喝了冰果汁。

questions.q: What number of oranges did Tom slice?
What did Tom put in the glass cup?
When did Tom drink the juice?

text.en: Cool autumn wind blew colorful leaves off old trees in the park. Children used red and yellow leaves to make art. Then they jumped into a soft pile of leaves.
text.zh: 凉凉的秋风把彩色叶子从公园的老树上吹下来。孩子们用红叶和黄叶做手工。然后，他们跳进软软的一堆叶子里。

questions.q: What blew the leaves off the trees?
What did children make with the leaves?

text.en: Mia found a tiny gray kitten under a wooden bench. She took it home and gave it a small dish of milk. The happy kitten made a soft sound and slept in her lap.
text.zh: 米娅在一张木长凳下发现一只小灰猫。她把小猫带回家，给它一小碟牛奶。开心的小猫轻轻地叫着，在她腿上睡着了。

questions.q: Where did Mia find the kitten?
What did Mia give the kitten?
Where did the kitten fall asleep?

text.en: David and his dad put up a green tent by a quiet river. At dusk, they cooked sweet marshmallows over a small fire. At night, they listened to crickets in the forest.
text.zh: 大卫和爸爸在安静的河边搭起绿色帐篷。黄昏时，他们在小火上烤甜棉花糖。晚上，他们听森林里的蟋蟀叫。

questions.q: Where did David and his dad pitch the tent?
What food did they roast over the campfire?
What sound did they listen to at night?

text.en: Giant pandas live in cool bamboo forests in the mountains. They eat green bamboo for most of the day. Their thick black-and-white fur keeps them warm in winter.
text.zh: 大熊猫生活在山上的凉爽竹林里。它们一天大部分时间都在吃绿竹子。黑白相间的厚毛让它们冬天保持温暖。

questions.q: What do pandas spend most of their day eating?
What does their thick fur do for them?

text.en: The yellow city bus goes down Main Street every fifteen minutes. Passengers tap plastic cards and sit by the clean windows. The driver tells everyone about the next stops.
text.zh: 黄色城市公交车每十五分钟经过主街。乘客刷塑料卡，然后坐在干净的窗边。司机告诉大家下一站。

questions.q: When does the city bus travel?
What do passengers use to pay for the ride?
What does the driver announce clearly?

text.en: Heavy white snow covered the whole yard on a cold January morning. Toby and his sister made a tall snowman with an orange carrot. They put a warm red scarf around the snowman's neck.
text.zh: 一月一个寒冷的早晨，厚厚的白雪盖住了整个院子。托比和姐姐用一根橙色胡萝卜做了一个高雪人。他们把暖和的红围巾围在雪人脖子上。

questions.q: What covered the yard in January?
What did they use for the snowman's nose?
Where did they wrap the red wool scarf?

text.en: The school bakery sells warm rolls every morning before the first class. Students wait quietly to buy honey bread and oat cookies. The money buys new storybooks for the school library.
text.zh: 学校面包店每天早上第一节课前卖热面包卷。学生们安静排队买蜂蜜面包和燕麦饼干。卖的钱用来给学校图书馆买新故事书。

questions.q: When does the school bakery sell rolls?
What does the school buy with the raised money?

text.en: Class Four went to the city aquarium to learn about sea animals. They watched colorful fish swim in clear blue tanks. The guide told them how sea turtles keep their eggs safe on sandy beaches.
text.zh: 四年级去了城市水族馆，学习海洋动物。他们看彩色鱼在清澈的蓝色水箱里游。导游告诉他们海龟怎样在沙滩上保护自己的蛋。

questions.q: What did Class Four go to the aquarium to learn about?
What swam through the blue water tanks?
What did the guide explain about sea turtles?

text.en: Sarah and her family put a red checked blanket on the grass. They ate turkey sandwiches, sweet grapes, and drank cold apple juice under a tree. After eating, they played frisbee near the pond.
text.zh: 莎拉和家人在草地上铺了一条红格子毯子。他们在树下吃火鸡三明治和甜葡萄，还喝冰苹果汁。吃完后，他们在池塘边玩飞盘。

questions.q: Where did Sarah's family lay their blanket?
options: On the grass under a tree

questions.q: What food and drinks did they enjoy?
What game did they play after eating?

text.en: Alex made a small toy robot with colorful blocks that snap together. The robot can roll on the wooden floor and flash yellow lights. Alex presses a red button to make it turn in circles.
text.zh: 亚历克斯用彩色拼插积木做了一个小玩具机器人。机器人能在木地板上滚动，还会闪黄灯。亚历克斯按红按钮，让它转圈。

questions.q: What did Alex use to build the robot?
What happens when Alex presses the red button?

text.en: A tall white lighthouse stands on a rocky cliff by the sea. Its strong light helps ships stay away from sharp rocks at night. The keeper checks the big light bulb every evening at sunset.
text.zh: 一座高高的白灯塔立在海边的岩石悬崖上。夜里，它的强光帮助船远离尖石头。看守人每天傍晚日落时检查大灯泡。

questions.q: Where does the white lighthouse stand?
What does the lighthouse beam do for ships?
When does the keeper check the light bulb?

text.en: Soft rain fell on the dry green grass all morning. Flowers opened their colorful petals to catch the fresh rain. Soon, a bright rainbow appeared in the clear blue sky.
text.zh: 整个上午，细雨落在干干的绿草上。花儿打开彩色花瓣接新鲜雨水。很快，明亮的彩虹出现在清蓝的天空中。

questions.q: What do flowers open their petals to catch?
What appeared across the sky after rain?

text.en: Grandpa made a small wooden toy train for Jack's eighth birthday. It has three dark red cars joined by tiny metal hooks. Jack rolls the train on a smooth track in his bedroom.
text.zh: 爷爷为杰克八岁生日做了一列小木玩具火车。它有三节深红色车厢，用小金属钩连在一起。杰克在卧室的平滑轨道上推火车。

questions.q: Who carved the wooden toy train?
What number of cars does the train have?
Where does Jack roll the train?
options: Along a smooth track in room

text.en: Mom made round golden pancakes for Sunday breakfast. She put sweet yellow honey and fresh strawberry slices on top. Everyone ate two pancakes before going to the park.
text.zh: 妈妈做了圆圆的金黄色煎饼当星期天早餐。她在上面放甜黄蜂蜜和新鲜草莓片。大家去公园前都吃了两张煎饼。

questions.q: When did Mom cook golden pancakes?
What did Mom add on top of pancakes?
Where did the family go after breakfast?

text.en: The fire station is in the middle of our small town. Three firefighters wear yellow suits and red helmets every day. When the alarm rings, they drive a big fire truck to help people. They work to keep the town safe.
text.zh: 消防站在我们小镇的中间。三名消防员每天穿黄色衣服和红色头盔。警报响起时，他们开大消防车去帮助大家。他们让小镇更安全。

questions.q: Where is the local fire station located?
options: In the middle of our town

questions.q: What color suits do the firefighters wear?
What vehicle do they drive when alarm sounds?

text.en: Lucas got a bright red bike for his eighth birthday. His older brother helped him on the park path. At first, Lucas felt scared and unsteady as he held the handlebars. After much practice, he could ride by himself.
text.zh: 卢卡斯八岁生日时得到一辆亮红色自行车。哥哥在公园小路上帮助他。开始时，他握着车把，觉得害怕又不稳。练习很多次后，他能自己骑车了。

questions.q: What gift did Lucas receive for his birthday?
What is Lucas like at first?

text.en: Students met in the gym for the yearly science show. Ella made a volcano with paper and brown clay. When she mixed vinegar and baking soda, red foam came out. Everyone cheered, and her project got a blue prize ribbon.
text.zh: 学生们在体育馆参加每年的科学展。艾拉用纸和棕色泥做了一座火山。她把醋和小苏打混在一起时，红泡沫冒了出来。大家都欢呼，她的作品得了蓝色奖带。

questions.q: Where was the science project show held?
What caused red foam to bubble out?

text.en: Sea turtles spend almost all their lives in the ocean. At night, mother turtles crawl onto sandy beaches to lay round eggs. They cover the nest with sand to keep the eggs safe from other animals. Weeks later, baby turtles come out and run to the sea.
text.zh: 海龟几乎一辈子都生活在海里。晚上，海龟妈妈爬上沙滩下圆圆的蛋。它们用沙子盖住窝，保护蛋不被别的动物吃掉。几周后，小海龟出来，跑向大海。

questions.q: Where do sea turtles spend almost their entire lives?
When do female turtles lay their eggs?
What do turtles protect with sand?
What do baby turtles do after hatching?

text.en: Class Three took a yellow school bus to the zoo. They saw two giant pandas eating bamboo leaves in the shade. Later, they watched a trainer feed fish to seals in a pool. Before going home, everyone bought animal bookmarks at the gift shop.
text.zh: 三年级的学生坐黄色校车去了动物园。他们看见两只大熊猫在阴凉处吃竹叶。后来，他们看训练员在池子里喂海豹吃鱼。回家前，大家在礼品店买了动物书签。

questions.q: What did Class Three use to travel to the zoo?
What animal was fed fish by the trainer?
What souvenir did students buy before leaving?

text.en: Autumn is the time to pick apples in local apple farms. Farmers pick many crisp red apples from tall trees every day. They put the apples neatly in strong wooden boxes. Soon, trucks take the boxes to markets in the nearby city.
text.zh: 秋天是当地苹果园摘苹果的时候。农民每天从高树上摘很多脆红苹果。他们把苹果整齐地放进结实的木箱。很快，卡车把箱子运到附近城市的市场。

questions.q: What season is the apple harvest?
What do farmers use to store the apples?
Where do trucks take the crates?

text.en: Mom mixed flour, warm water, and yeast in a big bowl. She worked the soft dough on a wooden board until it was smooth. After it grew bigger in a warm place, she baked it in the oven. The bread had a crisp outside and a soft middle.
text.zh: 妈妈把面粉、温水和酵母放在大碗里混合。她在木板上揉软面团，直到它变光滑。面团在暖和的地方变大后，她把它放进烤箱烤。面包外面脆，里面软。

questions.q: What ingredients did Mom mix together?
Where did Mom knead the dough?
What did Mom do before baking?
options: Let dough rise in warm spot

questions.q: What was the baked bread like?

text.en: Little penguins live in groups by the cold coast of Antarctica. They swim very fast in icy water to catch small fish. Their thick, oily feathers keep water out and keep heat in. At night, they stand close together to stay warm in the cold wind.
text.zh: 小企鹅成群生活在南极洲寒冷的海边。它们在冰水里游得很快，去抓小鱼。厚厚的油羽毛不让水进去，也把热留在身体里。晚上，它们挤在一起，在冷风中保持温暖。

questions.q: What do penguins swim fast to catch?
What do oily feathers do for penguins?
options: Keep water out and trap heat

questions.q: What do penguins do at night against cold winds?

text.en: Jack and his family put up a green tent by a mountain stream. In the afternoon, they walked on trails among pine trees. At sunset, they cooked fresh soup over a warm fire. After dark, they pointed at bright stars in the sky.
text.zh: 杰克和家人在山间小溪边搭起绿色帐篷。下午，他们在松树中间的小路上走路。日落时，他们在暖火上煮新鲜汤。天黑后，他们指着天上的亮星星。

questions.q: Where did Jack's family pitch their tent?
What activity did they do during the afternoon?
What food did they prepare over the campfire?
What do they look at after dark?

text.en: A honeybee home has many worker bees and one queen. Worker bees get sweet flower food from fields. They bring it back to the hive and make honey. Bees also help plants grow by carrying pollen from flower to flower.
text.zh: 一个蜂巢里有很多工蜂和一只蜂王。工蜂从田野的花朵上采甜花蜜。它们把花蜜带回蜂巢做成蜂蜜。蜜蜂还把花粉从一朵花带到另一朵花，帮助植物生长。

questions.q: What number of queens are in a honeybee colony?
What do worker bees collect from flowers?
What do worker bees make back at the hive?
What do honeybees do for plants?
options: Carrying pollen from flower to flower

text.en: Our city park is a green place in the town center. Families come on weekends to eat under tall maple trees. Children play on swings, slides, and climbing frames. A walking path goes around a quiet pond with ducks.
text.zh: 我们的城市公园是镇中心的一片绿色地方。家庭周末来高高的枫树下吃东西。孩子们玩秋千、滑梯和攀爬架。一条步道绕着有鸭子的安静池塘。

questions.q: Where is the city park located?
What kind of trees shade the picnic area?
What playground equipment do children use?
What animal lives in the park pond?

text.en: Big ships stop at the ocean harbor every morning. Giant cranes lift heavy metal boxes off the ships. Harbor workers guide trucks that carry the goods to nearby storehouses. Seagulls fly over the blue water looking for fish pieces.
text.zh: 每天早上，大船停在海港。巨大的吊车把重金属箱从船上吊下来。港口工人指挥卡车把货物运到附近仓库。海鸥在蓝水上飞，寻找小鱼块。

questions.q: What ships dock at the harbor every morning?
What machinery lifts heavy metal containers?
What birds fly above searching for fish scraps?

text.en: An artist puts soft gray clay on a turning wheel. She uses wet fingers to make the clay into a smooth bowl. After it dries, the bowl is baked in a very hot oven. At last, she paints colorful patterns on the bowl.
text.zh: 一位艺术家把软灰泥放在转盘上。她用湿手指把泥做成光滑的碗。碗变干后，放进很热的窑里烤。最后，她在碗上画彩色图案。

questions.q: What material does the artist place on the wheel?
What does the artist use to shape the clay?
Where is the bowl baked after drying?
What is the final step in making pottery?

text.en: Our solar system has the sun and eight planets that go around it. Earth is the third planet from the sun and has oceans of water. Mars is called the red planet because red iron dust covers its ground. Scientists send space robots to study faraway planets.
text.zh: 我们的太阳系有太阳和八颗绕着它转的行星。地球是离太阳第三近的行星，有很多海水。火星因为地面有红色铁尘，所以叫红色星球。科学家派太空机器人研究远处的行星。

questions.q: What number of planets orbit the sun in our solar system?
What position is Earth from the sun?

options: Rusty iron dust on its surface

questions.q: What do scientists send to explore distant planets?

text.en: The city library has many books in neat rows on shelves. Children come after school to do homework and read storybooks. Library workers help students find books for class work. Reading clubs meet every Saturday morning to share favorite stories.
text.zh: 城市图书馆的书整齐地排在书架上。孩子们放学后到这里做作业和读故事书。图书管理员帮助学生找上课要用的书。读书小组每个星期六早上见面，分享喜欢的故事。

questions.q: Where does the library keep its books?
When do children visit to do homework?
Who guides students to find reference books?
When do special reading clubs meet?

text.en: Deserts are dry places with very little rain all year. Camels can walk a long way there without water. Their wide, flat feet stop them from sinking in soft sand. Many desert plants keep water in thick stems to live in the hot sun.
text.zh: 沙漠是一年里很少下雨的干燥地方。骆驼在那里可以走很远，不喝水。它们宽平的脚不让它们陷进软沙里。很多沙漠植物把水存进粗茎里，在热太阳下生长。

questions.q: What can camels do without drinking water?
What do camels’ wide feet do?
Where do desert plants store water?
What weather condition do desert plants survive?

text.en: Doctor James Naismith made basketball in December 1891. He put two peach baskets on a gym balcony for the first goals. Players threw a soccer ball into the baskets to get points. Today, basketball is a popular game played by many people around the world.
text.zh: 詹姆斯·奈史密斯医生在1891年12月发明了篮球。他把两个桃子篮放在体育馆阳台上，当作最早的球篮。球员把足球扔进篮子得分。今天，篮球是世界上很多人玩的热门运动。

questions.q: What did Naismith use for the first goals?
What ball was used in the first basketball games?

text.en: Paper was first made in ancient China about two thousand years ago. An official named Cai Lun mixed tree bark, hemp, old rags, and water. He mashed the mix and pressed it flat to make sheets. Paper let people write books and keep records more easily.
text.zh: 大约两千年前，纸最早在中国古代做出来。一位叫蔡伦的官员把树皮、麻、旧布和水混在一起。他把这些东西捣碎，压成平纸。纸让人们更容易写书和记录事情。

questions.q: Who is credited with inventing paper?
What ingredients were combined to make paper pulp?
options: Tree bark, hemp, old rags, water

questions.q: What did Cai Lun do to make paper sheets?
options: Mashed into pulp and pressed flat

text.en: Coral reefs are colorful homes under the sea made by tiny coral animals. Sea turtles, clownfish, and crabs live there. The bright coral gives small fish a place to hide and food to eat. Keeping coral reefs safe helps ocean animals live well.
text.zh: 珊瑚礁是小珊瑚动物在海底做成的彩色家园。海龟、小丑鱼和螃蟹住在那里。明亮的珊瑚给小鱼藏身的地方和食物。保护珊瑚礁能让海洋动物好好生活。

text.en: Honeybees help flowers, fruit trees, and vegetables grow. One hive can have more than fifty thousand bees. Worker bees fly far each day to get pollen and sweet flower food. Without bees, many crops and fruits could not grow.
text.zh: 蜜蜂帮助花、果树和蔬菜生长。一个蜂巢里可以有五万多只蜜蜂。工蜂每天飞很远去采花粉和甜花蜜。没有蜜蜂，很多庄稼和水果就不能生长。

text.en: Wind is clean energy that will not run out. Big wind turbines stand on windy hills to catch moving air. When the blades turn, machines make electricity. Clean wind power can run homes and schools without making the air dirty.
text.zh: 风是一种用不完的清洁能源。大风力发电机立在有风的山上，接住流动的空气。叶片转动时，机器发电。清洁风电能给家和学校供电，不让空气变脏。

text.en: James Watt made the steam engine better long ago. It used hot steam from boiling water to move heavy parts and turn iron wheels. Steam engines ran early trains and factory machines. This new machine helped towns and factories grow fast.
text.zh: 很久以前，詹姆斯·瓦特改进了蒸汽机。它用开水的热蒸汽推动重部件，带动铁轮子转。蒸汽机带动早期火车和工厂机器。这个新机器让城镇和工厂很快发展。

text.en: Solar panels catch sunlight and turn it into electricity. Dark silicon cells on the panels take in sun rays on sunny days. A machine changes the electricity so home tools can use it. Solar power can save money and help keep Earth clean.
text.zh: 太阳能板接住阳光，把它变成电。板上的深色硅电池在晴天吸收太阳光。一台机器改变电流，让家里的电器能用。太阳能可以省钱，也帮助地球保持干净。

text.en: The rainforest canopy is the top layer made by tall tree branches. Most rainforest animals live high in this leafy layer. Toucans, monkeys, and tree frogs find fruit and hiding places there. Sunlight is bright at the top, but the forest floor is dark.
text.zh: 雨林树冠是高树枝形成的顶层。大部分雨林动物住在这片高高的树叶里。巨嘴鸟、猴子和树蛙在那里找水果和藏身处。上面阳光很亮，森林地面却很暗。

options: Dense upper layer of tall tree branches

text.en: Ancient Egyptians built pyramids as tombs for kings. Skilled workers moved many heavy limestone blocks to make them. The Great Pyramid of Giza was the tallest building made by people for many years. Today, visitors come from all over the world to see these stone buildings.
text.zh: 古埃及人建金字塔，给国王当坟墓。熟练工人搬来很多重石灰石块建造它们。吉萨大金字塔很多年都是人造的最高建筑。今天，世界各地的游客来参观这些石头建筑。

text.en: The deep ocean is cold, dark, and far below the sea surface. Sunlight cannot reach there, so sea animals live in darkness. Many deep-sea fish have glowing parts to catch food. Anglerfish and giant squid can live with the strong water pressure. Scientists use robot submarines to study this underwater world.
text.zh: 深海又冷又黑，在海面很深的下面。阳光到不了那里，所以海洋动物住在黑暗中。许多深海鱼有会发光的部分，用来找食物。琵琶鱼和大鱿鱼能在很强的水压下生活。科学家用机器人潜水艇研究这个水下世界。

text.en: The Great Wall of China is a famous old building. It goes for thousands of miles over mountains and northern deserts. Ancient soldiers built watchtowers on the wall to guard the country and send smoke signals. Many travelers visit places such as Badaling to walk on the old stones. The wall is still a proud sign of Chinese history and building skill.
text.zh: 中国长城是世界上很有名的古建筑。它越过高山和北方沙漠，延伸几千英里。古代士兵在长城上修了烽火台，保护国家、传递烟火信号。很多游客去八达岭等地方走在古老的石头上。长城今天仍是中国历史和建造本领的骄傲象征。

text.en: Bi Sheng made movable-type printing in China in the eleventh century. He carved Chinese characters on small clay blocks and baked them hard. Later, Johannes Gutenberg made a metal printing press in Germany. Books could then be made faster and more cheaply than writing by hand. This helped more people read and learn around the world.
text.zh: 毕昇在11世纪的中国发明了活字印刷。他把汉字刻在小泥块上，再把它们烧硬。后来，约翰内斯·古腾堡在德国做了金属印刷机。书可以比手写得更快、更便宜。这帮助世界上更多人读书和学习。

text.en: Green plants make their food in a process called photosynthesis. Plant roots take water and minerals from the soil. Green leaves take a gas called carbon dioxide from the air and catch sunlight. Sunlight changes the water and gas into sugar and oxygen. This gives people and animals oxygen to breathe.
text.zh: 绿色植物用一个叫光合作用的过程做自己的食物。植物的根从泥土里吸收水和矿物质。绿叶从空气里吸收一种叫二氧化碳的气体，还接住阳光。阳光把水和气体变成糖和氧气。这给人和动物呼吸用的氧气。

text.en: Mars is the fourth planet from the sun. Scientists send robot cars, such as Perseverance, to study its dry, rocky ground. These robots take clear photos and drill rocks to check them. They look for old signs of water life in dry lakebeds. Future space trips hope to send people to Mars.
text.zh: 火星是离太阳第四近的行星。科学家派“毅力号”等机器人车研究它干燥、多石的地面。这些机器人拍清楚的照片，还钻开石头检查。它们在干涸湖床找过去有水中生命的痕迹。未来的太空旅行希望把人送到火星。

text.en: Clean energy comes from natural things that can be used again and again. Solar panels use sunlight to make electricity. Wind turbines use moving air, and dams use flowing water to make electricity. Homes and cities can use this clean power. Clean energy makes less dirty air and helps the world stay safe.
text.zh: 清洁能源来自可以一直再用的自然事物。太阳能板用阳光发电。风力发电机用流动的空气，水坝用流动的水发电。家和城市都能用这种清洁电。清洁能源让脏空气变少，帮助保护世界。

text.en: Honeybees help wild plants and farm crops grow. One worker bee can visit more than one thousand flowers in a day to get nectar. Pollen sticks to its fuzzy body and moves from flower to flower. This helps plants make seeds, nuts, and fruit. Protecting bees helps us have enough food.
text.zh: 蜜蜂帮助野生植物和农田作物生长。一只工蜂一天可以去一千多朵花上采花蜜。花粉粘在它毛茸茸的身体上，被带到别的花上。这帮助植物结种子、坚果和水果。保护蜜蜂能帮助我们有足够的食物。

text.en: People dreamed of flying like birds for thousands of years. In 1903, Orville and Wilbur Wright made the first airplane with a motor. Their plane flew for twelve seconds over the sandy hills of Kitty Hawk. Today, jet planes carry hundreds of people over oceans in a few hours. Modern planes connect people and places around the world.
text.zh: 几千年来，人们梦想像鸟一样飞翔。1903年，奥维尔和威尔伯·莱特做了第一架有发动机的飞机。他们的飞机在基蒂霍克的沙丘上飞了12秒。今天，喷气式飞机几个小时就能载几百人飞过大洋。现代飞机连接了世界各地的人和地方。

text.en: Some living things make light in dark places. In the ocean, changes inside animals can make blue or green light. Tiny plankton glow when waves hit the shore at night. Deep-sea jellyfish flash light to scare hungry animals away. Scientists study this light to make new medical tools and colors.
text.zh: 有些活的东西会在黑暗处发光。在海洋里，动物身体里的变化能发出蓝光或绿光。晚上，海浪打到岸边时，小浮游生物会发亮。深海水母闪光，吓走饥饿的动物。科学家研究这种光，做新的医疗工具和颜色。

text.en: Great inventions change daily life for people. Thomas Edison made a useful electric light bulb in 1879. Alexander Graham Bell made the first telephone to send voices on wires. Modern inventors make smart computers and clean-energy tools to solve problems. Curiosity and hard work help people make new things.
text.zh: 伟大的发明会改变人们的日常生活。托马斯·爱迪生在1879年做出实用的电灯泡。亚历山大·格雷厄姆·贝尔做了第一部电话，让声音在线里传送。现在的发明家做智能电脑和清洁能源工具来解决问题。好奇心和努力帮助人们做出新东西。

desc.zh: 询问数量或多少。

writing.en: If you could do one amazing thing for a day, what would you do? How would you help a friend? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你一天能做一件很棒的事，你会做什么？你会怎么帮助朋友？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: Imagine you find a small door in your room. Where does it go? What do you see? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 想象你在房间里找到一扇小门。它通向哪里？你看到了什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What do you like to do after school? Why do you like it? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 放学后你喜欢做什么？你为什么喜欢它？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: Imagine you have a helper at home. What job would it do? Why would it help you? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 想象你家里有一个小帮手。它会做什么事？它为什么能帮到你？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: Describe your dream small house. What rooms and games would be inside? Why? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 描述你梦想中的小房子。里面会有什么房间和游戏？为什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: Imagine you go on a trip. Where would you go? What would you see there? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 想象你去旅行。你会去哪里？你会在那里看到什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: Write a story about a pet that can talk. What funny things would your pet say to you? Why? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 写一个关于会说话的宠物的故事。你的宠物会对你说什么有趣的话？ 为什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: Imagine you can fly high in the sky. Where would you go? Who would you take with you? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 想象你能飞到高高的天空。你会去哪里？你会带谁一起去？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: Who is your best friend? What are three fun things you love to do together? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 谁是你最好的朋友？你们最喜欢一起做的三件有趣的事情是什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If it rained your favorite food instead of water, what food would it be? How would you collect it? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果天上下的不是雨而是你最喜欢的食物，那会是什么？你会怎么把它们收集起来？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What is the best gift you ever received? Why is it special to you? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 你收到的最好的礼物是什么？它为什么对你很特别？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If you could talk to any ocean animal, which one would it be? What would you ask them? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你能和任何海洋动物说话，你想和哪种说话？你会问他们什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What does your family do together on a special day? Why is it fun? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 你的家人在特别的日子会一起做什么？为什么这很有趣？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: Imagine you spent a day living in a cartoon world. What cartoon would it be and what would you do? Why? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 想象你在卡通世界里生活了一天。那会是哪个卡通，你会做什么？ 为什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If you could fly, where would you go first? What would you see? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你能飞，你会先去哪里？你会看到什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What is your favorite game to play with your family? Why is it so exciting? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 你最喜欢和家人玩什么游戏？为什么它这么令人兴奋？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If you could change one school rule, what rule would you change? What would the new rule be? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你能改变一条学校规则，你会改变哪一条？新的规则会是什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What is your favorite meal that your parents cook? Why do you like it so much? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 你父母做的饭菜里你最喜欢哪一道？为什么你这么喜欢它？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If you found a magic lamp with three wishes, what would your first wish be? Why? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你发现了一个可以满足三个愿望的神灯，你的第一个愿望会是什么？为什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What movie or TV show do you like? Who do you like in it? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 你喜欢什么电影或电视节目？你喜欢里面的谁？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If you could build a house out of candy, what sweets would you use for the walls and roof? Why? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你能用糖果建一座房子，你会用什么甜食来做墙壁和屋顶？ 为什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What is your favorite outdoor activity in spring? How does it make you feel? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 春天你最喜欢的户外活动是什么？它让你感觉怎么样？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If you had a pet dragon, what would you name it? Where would you take your dragon to play? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你有一只宠物龙，你会给它取什么名字？你会带你的龙去哪里玩？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What is your favorite thing about your school classroom? What makes your classroom special? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 关于你的学校教室，你最喜欢什么？是什么让你的教室很特别？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If you could grow a plant in a magic garden, what would grow there? Why? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你能在魔法花园里种一种植物，那里会长出什么？为什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What is your favorite sport or physical activity? What do you like most about it? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的体育活动是什么？你最喜欢它的什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If you could visit a place from long ago, where would you go? What would you do there? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你能去很久以前的一个地方，你会去哪里？你会在那里做什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What sweet food do you like at a party? Why do you like it? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 在派对上你喜欢吃什么甜食？你为什么喜欢它？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: Imagine you could talk to birds. What news would they bring you from the sky? Why? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 想象你能和鸟儿说话。它们会从天上为你带来什么消息？ 为什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: Where do you like to rest when you are tired? What do you do there? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 累的时候你喜欢在哪里休息？你在那里做什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If you could make a new playground slide, what color would it be? Would it be straight or curved? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你能做一个新的游乐场滑梯，它会是什么颜色？它会是直的还是弯的？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What is your favorite thing to do on a rainy afternoon indoors? Why? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 下雨的下午在室内你最喜欢做什么？ 为什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If you could be as quiet as a mouse for one hour, where would you go? What would you do? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你能像老鼠一样安静一小时，你会去哪里？你会做什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What sea animal do you like to see at a place with fish? Why do you like it? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 在有鱼的地方，你喜欢看什么海洋动物？你为什么喜欢它？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If you were the teacher for one day, what fun lesson would you teach your class? Why? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你能当一天老师，你会给全班上一堂什么有趣的课？ 为什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What is your favorite day from a past holiday? Who was with you? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 过去假期里你最喜欢哪一天？谁和你在一起？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If you could open a small shop, what cool things would you sell inside? Why? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你能开一家小店，你会卖哪些酷炫的东西？ 为什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What is your favorite fruit juice or drink? How often do you get to drink it? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的果汁或饮料是什么？你多久能喝一次？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If your pet could wear clothes, what would it wear? What color would the clothes be? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你的宠物能穿衣服，它会穿什么？衣服会是什么颜色？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What do you like about sleeping outside under the stars? What food would you eat? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 你喜欢在星星下睡在外面的什么？你会吃什么食物？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If you found a surprise box, what would be inside? Why would you like it? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你找到一个惊喜盒子，里面会有什么？你为什么喜欢它？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What game do you like to play with family or friends? Why is it fun? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 你喜欢和家人或朋友玩什么游戏？为什么它很有趣？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If you could build a big snow castle in winter, who would help you? What would you do inside? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你能在冬天建一座大雪城堡，谁会帮你？你会在里面做什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What is your favorite song to listen to when you are happy? Why do you like the music? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 当你高兴的时候你最喜欢听什么歌？你为什么喜欢这音乐？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If you were as small as an ant, where would you go? What would you see? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你和蚂蚁一样小，你会去哪里？你会看到什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What is your favorite season of the year? What do you love doing during that season? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 一年中你最喜欢的季节是什么？你在那个季节最喜欢做什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If you had a magic pencil, what would you draw? What would your drawing do? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你有一支神奇的铅笔，你会画什么？你的画会做什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What is your favorite subject at school? What new things did you learn recently? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 学校里你最喜欢的科目是什么？你最近学到了什么新知识？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If you could build your own bicycle, what color would it be? What could it do? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你能自己造一辆自行车，它会是什么颜色？它能做什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What good time did you have with your grandparents? What did you do together? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 你和祖父母一起度过了什么快乐时光？你们一起做了什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If you could visit a zoo, what animals would you watch? Why would you watch them? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你能去动物园，你会看什么动物？你为什么想看它们？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What is your favorite kind of pizza topping? Why is it the tastiest? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的披萨馅料是什么？为什么它最美味？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If you could watch a monkey for one day, what funny things would it do? What would you call it? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你能看一只猴子一天，它会做什么有趣的事？你会叫它什么名字？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What is your favorite craft activity? What materials do you use to make it? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的手工活动是什么？你用什么材料制作它？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If you could fly in a hot air balloon, where would you go? What would you see? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你能坐热气球飞行，你会去哪里？你会看到什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What is your favorite kind of weather? What do you like to do outside? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 你最喜欢什么天气？在户外你喜欢做什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If you could make a new ice cream, what food would you put in it? Why would it taste good? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你能做一种新冰淇淋，你会放什么食物？它为什么会好吃？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: Who is your favorite person in a storybook? Why do you like this person? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 谁是你最喜欢的故事书人物？你为什么喜欢这个人？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: If you could make a new festival in your town, what would people do? What food would they eat? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 如果你能在你的镇上办一个新节日，人们会做什么？他们会吃什么？试着写三句短句。

writing.en: What good thing did you do at school this year? How did you do it? Try to write 3 short sentences.
writing.zh: 今年你在学校做了什么好事？你是怎么做到的？试着写三句短句。

speaking.en: Look at the cute puppy over there.

speaking.en: I can sing and dance very well.

speaking.en: Where is your schoolbag?

speaking.en: My father drives me to school every day.

My brother likes playing video games.
speaking.zh: 我哥哥喜欢玩电子游戏。

I am so happy to see you.
I like to read books in the library.
What time do you go to school?
My favorite color is blue.
speaking.zh: 我最喜欢的颜色是蓝色。

speaking.en: Can you help me with my homework?
There are many apples in the basket.
The weather is sunny and warm today.
I want to be a doctor when I grow up.
speaking.zh: 我长大后想当一名医生。

Where is the nearest supermarket?
We eat lunch at twelve o'clock.
Do you have a pet at home?
It is important to brush your teeth.
Look at the birds in the sky.
My brother plays basketball every Sunday.
speaking.zh: 我弟弟每个星期天都打篮球。

speaking.en: Please pass me the salt.

The school bus is yellow.

speaking.zh: 她穿着一件漂亮的连衣裙。

How many students are in your class?

Today is my father's birthday.

What time do you go to school?
My favorite fruit is a red apple.
speaking.zh: 我最喜欢的水果是红苹果。

speaking.en: Can you play basketball with me?
speaking.zh: 你能和我一起打篮球吗？

speaking.en: There are forty students in my class.
She is wearing a beautiful blue dress.
speaking.zh: 她穿着一件漂亮的蓝裙子。

speaking.en: It is sunny and warm today.
I want to be a teacher when I grow up.
speaking.zh: 我长大后想成为一名老师。

speaking.en: Where is my pencil box?
Let us go to the park this afternoon.
speaking.zh: 让我们今天下午去公园吧。

speaking.en: How many brothers do you have?

Do you like to eat noodles for breakfast?

Please open your book to page ten.
My father drives a white car.
speaking.zh: 我爸爸开一辆白色的车。

speaking.en: Winter is cold and it often snows.
speaking.zh: 冬天很冷，而且经常下雪。

speaking.en: Look at the colorful flowers in the garden.
speaking.zh: 看花园里五颜六色的花。

speaking.en: I am taller than my little brother.
Do you have a pet at home?
The school bus is coming now.
We study math, science and art.
speaking.zh: 我们学习数学、科学和美术。

speaking.en: Have a nice day, my friend!
speaking.zh: 祝你有美好的一天，我的朋友！

vocab.answer: 澳大利亚的；澳大利亚人
